messages:
incident-bot: Pager: prod - prompt-router-v2 canary error rate exceeded threshold (5%) for 2m. Triggered by healthcheck anomalies and 502 spikes. Runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/prompt-router-canary

alex: on it, picking this up (oncall). DMing PD.

incident-bot: Alert details: alert_id=PRV2-9345, region=us-west1, deploy_tag=deploy-2026-03-17-06. Canary slice=5% traffic.

mira: seeing lots of backend 502s from taskrunner behind prompt-router-v2, started ~06:11 UTC right after canary. quick log sample:
```
[06:11:03] ERROR prompt-router-v2: upstream request failed status=502 id=xyz123 latency=12.3ms
[06:11:05] ERROR prompt-router-v2: upstream request failed status=502 id=xyz124 latency=0.9ms
[06:12:18] WARN  kv-cache: miss spike ~+40%
```

sam: possible regression in header handling or kernel selection fallback. simplest mitigation is to cut canary traffic -> flip feature flag that routes canary to new endpoint. ff name: `ff_prompt_mux_v2`.

jordan: support telemetry shows customers sourcetier=mid and above hitting 8-15% request failures in last 10m (not universal). Notified CS for targeted outreach.

alex: executing mitigation: `/ff toggle ff_prompt_mux_v2 off --env prod --by alex --reason "canary 502 spike"`

feature-flag-service: ff_prompt_mux_v2 set to OFF in prod at 06:15:12 UTC by alex (propagation to edge ~30s).

mira: confirming — traffic moved back to stable prompt-router. error rate dropping in quick checks.

jordan: current numbers: global error rate for prompt endpoints down from 9.8% -> 0.9% over 5m, affected customers list attached: [acme-corp, beta-analytics, delta-retail]. CS pinged.

pm-ana: please get CS to notify top impacted customers with severity and ETA. Any customers breached SLA?

support-sarah: CS here — contacting top 3 now using template: short summary + mitigation + offered postmortem. No confirmed SLA breaches so far, still confirming request counts. Will update thread.

liam: taking watch for next 6h. handing off from alex. liam oncall contact: pagerduty / oncall.

alex: handoff notes -> root cause suspected compatibility of new prompt-router kernel with certain quantized model paths; mitigated by flag flip. follow-ups: run full canary logs, run diag tests, delay redeploy until fixes. Link to logs: https://redwood/logs/PRV2/1987654321

sam: will create a draft postmortem and list of reproduction steps, assigning to eng-ml and eng-runtime.

support-sarah: CS update sent to acme-corp and beta-analytics, got ack from acme asking for ETA on fix. told them we rolled back canary and investigating; offering 1:1 call if needed.

incident-bot: Resolved: alert PRV2-9345 resolved at 06:24:30 UTC. Error rate returned to baseline (<1%). Mitigation = feature flag rollback (ff_prompt_mux_v2 OFF).

alex: closing handoff — liam please page if error resurfaces or if customer escalations spike. will follow up in postmortem thread. :thumbsup:

liam: ack, monitoring dashboards and alert thresholds tightened for next 12h. will escalate to on-call rotations if needed.

pm-ana: thanks — please include customer outreach logs and timeline in postmortem.

sam: created tracking ticket INF-2026-58 for RCA and remediation (assign: mira + eng-ml).

alex: good job team, short and sharp.
